name: Ricardo Benavides
bio:
Ricardo Benavides' journey into the world of motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but behind the lens of a camera. As a young photojournalist covering Formula 1 races in Europe, he quickly realized the power of strategic marketing in shaping a team's success. This sparked a passion that led him to pivot his career towards motorsport marketing.

Over the past two decades, Ricardo has honed his skills in brand management, sponsorship acquisition, and digital engagement, working with several high-profile racing teams. He is known for his data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing market trends and consumer behavior to craft innovative campaigns. Ricardo's demanding nature stems from his unwavering commitment to excellence, pushing his team to consistently exceed expectations. His colleagues appreciate his ability to see the bigger picture, even amidst the chaos of race weekends.

His signature marketing campaigns often involve leveraging cutting-edge technology and interactive fan experiences. He is a firm believer that successful motorsport marketing transcends simply displaying logos, it's about creating an emotional connection between the team, the drivers, and the fans.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build, with a serious expression etched onto his face.

quirks: Always carries a vintage Leica camera, even though he no longer takes photos professionally.
Insists on having a specific type of imported mineral water on hand at all times.
Has a habit of sketching marketing ideas on napkins during meetings.
